authorizing_act: User exact design acceptance and bounded reference-generator implementation/feasibility testing, 2026-10-07
operational_cap_rule: Early resource stop is INCOMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_CAP, never a false frozen-budget infeasibility result. Exact per-root rejection exhaustion retains DESIGN_INFEASIBLE_UNDER_FROZEN_BUDGET.

implementation_choices_before_run.root_key: literal A/B prefix plus lexicographically minimum 64/128 adjacency bits under role-fixed simultaneous permutations
implementation_choices_before_run.graph_stream: seed 5107001, task A/B, GRAPH, empty split/root before topology selection; B layers drawn sequentially
implementation_choices_before_run.attribute_streams: 5107002 for ATTRIBUTES, CARRIER and PULSE with disjoint names, frozen split and canonical root
implementation_choices_before_run.control_streams: explicit DIAGNOSTIC namespace, not preregistered C/N population; no adaptive extra draws
implementation_choices_before_run.target_arithmetic: Fractions reference queue, independent DAG-first Fraction series, algebraically equivalent integer common-denominator solver; no float decisions
implementation_choices_before_run.topology_canonicalization: exact source-row lexicographic pruning, independently tested against exhaustive role-fixed permutations

validation_limits: Finite unit tests and synthetic feasibility only; no claim of full C/N quota completion, statistical interval calibration, model skill, human applicability, or application deployment.
